stemMd: Why did testing with ordinary tools matter?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It checked whether replacement was workable in realistic maintenance conditions.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It proved drawings have no design value.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It removed the need for maintenance workers.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It made every module identical in shape.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It guaranteed that no bench would ever be damaged.

explanationMd: Ordinary tools approximate what workers can actually use on site. The test therefore examines practical effort and access, not just theoretical separability. It helps bridge design intent and maintenance reality.

distractorRationale.e: Maintenance testing does not eliminate future damage.
distractorRationale.b: The passage questions relying on drawings alone.
distractorRationale.d: Tool choice does not imply identical module geometry.
